info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Unit Financial Operations API
info.description: The Business Unit Financial Operations API provides access to vital financial data for various business units within the organization. It allows users to retrieve comprehensive financial records, including budgets, expenditures, and revenue streams that are essential for informed decision-making. This API is targeted towards finance teams, business analysts, and operational managers who require up-to-date financial insights for performance tracking and strategic planning. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their financial transparency and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve financial operations for business units.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the financial operations associated with different business units. Utilize it to gain insights into the financial performance and activities within each unit.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch financial operations related to business units. It includes parameters necessary for retrieving the specific financial data needed for analysis and reporting.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested financial operations data.
